# Green Vatika Nursery

> Green Vatika is a premier plant nursery and landscape design enterprise based in Narsinghpur, Madhya Pradesh, India. We specialize in air-purifying indoor house plants, outdoor garden plants, grafted fruit trees, exotic succulents, ficus bonsai, handcrafted planters, organic soil mixes, and professional landscape maintenance (AMC).

## Core Offerings

- [Indoor House Plants](https://greenvatika.co/#shop): Air-purifying Snake Plants, Peace Lilies, Areca Palms, Monstera Deliciosa, Money Plants, and Rubber Plants.
- [Outdoor & Flowering Plants](https://greenvatika.co/#categories): Bougainvillea, Hibiscus, Rose, Jasmine, Jasmine Mogra, and seasonal bloomers.
- [Fruit Trees & Saplings](https://greenvatika.co/#categories): Grafted Mango (Dasheri, Alphonso), All-Season Meyer Lemon, Guava, Pomegranate, and Papaya.
- [Exotic Succulents & Bonsai](https://greenvatika.co/#categories): Jade Plants, Aloe Vera, Echeveria, Ficus Bonsai, and Zamioculcas (ZZ Plant).
- [Organic Soil & Care Essentials](https://greenvatika.co/#shop): Washed Coco Peat, Vermicompost, Organic Neem Cake Fertilizer, Bone Meal, and Perlite soil mixes.
- [Landscape Services & AMC](https://greenvatika.co/#services): Garden design, terrace garden setup, vertical living green walls, and Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC).

- [NASA Air Purifying Indoor Plants Guide](https://greenvatika.co/#blog): Best plants to eliminate indoor toxins and boost bedroom oxygen levels.
- [Houseplant Overwatering Prevention](https://greenvatika.co/#blog): How to avoid root rot using the 2-inch soil moisture finger test.
- [Balcony Lemon Gardening Masterclass](https://greenvatika.co/#blog): Growing all-season grafted Meyer lemons in containers.
- [Monsoon Plant Care & Drainage](https://greenvatika.co/#blog): Protecting balcony and garden foliage from heavy rain damage.
- [Organic Potting Mix Masterclass](https://greenvatika.co/#blog): The ideal 50-30-20 ratio of Coco Peat, Vermicompost, and Perlite.
